caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest or cabinet with three short legs visible. The chest is shown in a three-quarter view, revealing the front and the left side. Its primary color is brown, resembling wood, with darker brown striations to simulate wood grain. The front of the chest has three decorative panels: the left and right panels are square with a symmetrical dark red line pattern and corner accents in red, while the center panel is rectangular and features a stylized yellow floral motif with a red flower at the top. Below these panels, there are three smaller drawer-like sections. The left and right drawers are yellow-beige with black and green plant-like motifs and dark round knobs; the center drawer is brown with an engraved red flower, the letters "E C," a small heart, and light blue and red dots. The chest's legs and lower framework have additional red floral embellishments. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige.
title: Painted Chest
